title: DecisionLogEntry
description: A single decision record appended to decision-log.jsonl. Captures governance decisions with v2 fields for reversibility (R9), effective autonomy (R10), nemawashi walkthrough (R5), and andon resolution (R3).

decision_id.description: Unique identifier for this decision. Format: DEC-NNNN.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this decision was made.

council_agents_involved.description: Agent IDs that contributed to this decision.

evidence_cited.description: Evidence items cited in support of this decision.

decision_type.description: Category of decision (e.g. course-correction-minor, course-correction-major, andon-resolution, yokoten-ratification, plan-bridge). `plan-bridge` is emitted by /henkaten-council:from-plan when a plan-mode artifact is persisted and routed; the evidence_cited array carries the plan body's sha256.

decision_outcome.description: Final outcome of this decision. `halted` is used when a sprint or loop terminates without applying the decision — e.g., after an andon stop, a no-progress determination on the henka side, or a harness-imposed resource cap. `superseded` is used when a later decision replaces this one before it was applied.

applied_automatically.description: True if the orchestrator applied this automatically (Level 3 minor reversible).

user_approval_required.description: True if this decision required explicit user approval.

user_approval_status.description: Current status of user approval, or null if not required.

affected_files.description: File paths modified by this decision.

linked_henka_id.description: HK-NNNN identifier of a related henkaten record, if any.

sprint_context.description: Sprint number during which this decision was made.

autonomy_level_used.description: Nominal autonomy level of the agent that made this decision.

effective_autonomy_at_decision.description: Effective autonomy level at the time of decision (may differ from nominal due to dynamic floor R10). R10.

reversibility.description: Whether the action(s) taken by this decision are reversible. Irreversible decisions auto-escalate to Level 5 regardless of nominal level (R9).

nemawashi_walkthrough_version.description: Filename of the nemawashi position paper (e.g. DEC-0042.md or DEC-0042-rev2.md). Null for minor single-prompt decisions. R5.

andon_resolution.description: Present if this decision resolved an andon signal. R3.

originator.description: Agent ID that issued the original andon signal.

swarm.description: Agent IDs included in the swarm response.

resolution.description: How the andon signal was resolved.

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds from andon signal to resolution.

description.description: Human-readable description of what was decided and why.
